advisories.title: Remove the unrelated Go contract example
advisories.body: The TypeScript-only implementation contract adds a documentation-only Go `CapabilityContext` solely for workflow-template compliance. It creates a second, disconnected representation of staff identity that readers can mistake for a maintained interface. Remove the Go block; the preceding TypeScript `StaffIdentity` already specifies this system's contract.
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_techspec.md:207 introduces a Go struct while the specified authorization module and interfaces at :17 and :149-179 are TypeScript → Improvement: removes a non-executable duplicate identity contract that can drift from the maintained interface → Fix: delete lines 207-216.
rg -n 'export async function' app/admin/_actions lib/auth/authorization.ts → the implemented authorization and server-action surface is TypeScript; no Go runtime component exists.

advisories.title: Align the final-document action names with the exported API
advisories.body: The final-document action table names `issueDecision`, `issueContract`, and `listIssuedDocumentHistory`, but the current server-action module exports `exportDecision`, `exportContract`, and `getIssuedDocumentHistory`. A technical specification is used to locate and test boundaries; these stale identifiers make implementation and coverage work unnecessarily error-prone. Rename the table entries to the actual exports (or explicitly state intended aliases and add them).
evidence: Premise: .compozy/tasks/donor-first-role-access/_techspec.md:407-411 documents identifiers that differ from the action module's exports → Improvement: lets implementers and test authors map the specification directly to the protected endpoints → Fix: replace the three stale table identifiers with `exportDecision`, `exportContract`, and `getIssuedDocumentHistory`, respectively.

app/admin/_actions/admin-actions.ts:485,735,834 → exports are `exportDecision`, `exportContract`, and `getIssuedDocumentHistory`; no `issueDecision`, `issueContract`, or `listIssuedDocumentHistory` action is exported.

suppressions.candidate: Timestamp fields are shown as strings rather than Date values in an illustrative interface.
suppressions.note: The document does not prescribe serialization internals, and server-action payloads can legitimately serialize timestamps as strings; no bounded improvement is established.
